name: react-native-feedback
description: Pluggable feedback & roadmap board for React Native, React and the web

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kobecuppens/feedback-core && npm run build -w @kobecuppens/react-native-feedback -w @kobecuppens/react-feedback
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web && npm run db:migrate:remote -w @feedback/worker && npm run deploy -w @feedback/worker
